From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Emma Willis <emma@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Simon Park <simon@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Runway closure readiness: 48-hour commit heat-check

Team / Acme —

We have ~48 hours before the close window where finance will lock in Q1 revenue. Quick heat-check: I attached the commit_roster_v3.xlsx and a short assumptions PDF. Please confirm the following items by EOD today (Feb 10 PT):

1) Stage changes: any ACV numbers that need to move from Negotiation -> Commit or Commit -> Closed.
2) PO timing: will Acme be able to issue a PO with the requested effective date (2/12)? If not, call out what date will be on the PO.
3) Contingencies: any blockers (legal redlines, procurement SSO, SOC2 paperwork) that would stop finance from counting this in Q1.

Action requests (explicit):
- Ben: update the roster with final owner confirmations and expected invoice date.
- Monica: confirm if CS has the onboarding start date locked; if it slips past 2/14 we need to flag.
- Acme (Emma): confirm PO ETA and whether Simon will sign or route to procurement.
- David: finance needs to confirm whether we can accept PO dates through 2/13 given close schedule.

If you hit any unknowns, call them out and we’ll escalate to a short bridge. I’m standing up a 20-min checkpoint at 10:30 PT if helpful.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah — quick updates below and I attached a small CSV with line-level notes.

- ACV & stage changes:
  • ACME-Portal (deal ACME-001): moving Negotiation -> Commit, sales-accepted pricing. Expected close = 2/11, target invoice date 2/12.
  • ACME-Ads (deal ACME-002): still in Procurement; procurement asked for an SSO cert — target slip to next quarter unless PO arrives by 2/13.

- Owners confirmed: Owner column updated for both deals; I added expected invoice and billing contact.
- Risk flags: Ads deal dependent on procurement SSO (Monica to confirm onboarding duration).

I’ve attached ben-updates.csv with the owner and invoice-date columns filled in. I’ll be on the 10:30 checkpoint and can run the commit roster live.

Ben Carter
